title: BMW Canada further improves EV convenience in Canada with Shell Recharge integration and access to NACS-format Superchargers (2026-04-08)
notes: Re-read 2026-11-19: all BEV models become Supercharger-compatible once software prerequisites are met (except original i3 and MINI Cooper SE F56); existing CCS-port cars must use the approved Lectron Vortex Plus NACS-to-CCS adapter. The i4 is not named in the text. All-new BMW models in Canada starting in 2026 (iX3, i3) get a built-in NACS port; only those.
